identity_and_theme.app_type: B2B SaaS Outbound & CRM Workspace Dashboard
identity_and_theme.design_philosophy: Bold, energetic, and visually rich B2B CRM experience using warm terracotta and vibrant orange accents, tactile step cards, animated micro-interactions, glowing badges, and staggered motion, breaking away from flat boxy admin forms.
core_aesthetic_rules: Never use generic flat muted tint boxes with plain divider lines for forms.
Replace flat FormSection borders with rounded-2xl cards with soft warm gradient fills, animated step badges (e.g. 01, 02, 03), and glowing icon headers.
Enhance all inputs with tactile focus rings (ring-2 ring-primary-500/20 border-primary-500), subtle icon color shifts, and warm inner shadows.
Right-side ICP Live Preview must feel like an active AI Pulse Radar with energetic gradients, live match completeness meters, and drifting pill badges.
Leads Search Summary must serve as an active dynamic 'Match Gauge' with live pulse indicators and pill counters.
Keep all existing 2-pane structure on ICP Engine and vertical layout structure on Leads page completely intact.
Preserve all existing data-testid attributes and React state/handlers without breaking functionality.

FormSection.treatment: Transform into visually rich, numbered step cards with rounded-2xl corners, subtle gradient backgrounds, warm orange border accent lines, and animated step badges.

FieldInput.treatment: Enhance inputs with crisp 1px borders, smooth focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary-500/20 focus:border-primary-500), and animated icon color shifts on focus.

MultiSelectDropdown.treatment: Provide vivid pill chips with spring animations, warm subtle hover states, and smooth multi-select popover triggers.

StatCard.treatment: Add vibrant gradient icon badges, smooth hover lift (-translate-y-1), and clear tabular font counts.

DataTable.treatment: Ensure clean zebra borders, active checkbox styling, and subtle hover row highlight with warm orange tint.

accessibility_and_testids.contrast_policy: All body text must achieve > 4.5:1 APCA contrast ratio against surface (#FFFFFF) and background (#FBF7F4). Primary buttons use white text (#FFFFFF) over #F9622C for high legibility.
accessibility_and_testids.data_testid_preservation: CRITICAL: Under no circumstances alter or remove any existing data-testid attributes (such as icp-page, icp-form, icp-product-name-input, icp-generate-button, icp-live-preview, icp-results-card, leads-page, leads-filter-form, leads-search-summary, leads-table, etc.). All automated tests depend on these exact strings.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do NOT redesign page layouts or routing — strictly keep the 2-pane structure for ICP Engine and the vertical filter-stats-table flow for Leads.
2. Upgrade FormSection component (/app/frontend/src/components/smady/FormSection.tsx) to support visual step badges, gradient backgrounds, and icon headers while retaining all existing props.
3. Revamp ICPEngine page (/app/frontend/src/pages/ICPEngine.tsx) with high-energy warm orange gradients, live preview radar styling, and staggered Framer Motion entrances for results.
4. Revamp Leads page (/app/frontend/src/pages/Leads.tsx) with dynamic search summary match gauge, vibrant stat cards, and rich table row styling.
5. Ensure all data-testid attributes remain exactly as defined in the original components.
6. Verify build passes without TypeScript or JSX errors.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_slop: Avoid generic centered white box layouts. Use warm orange gradient accents, depth with z-index hierarchy, soft inner borders, and energetic step indicators.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.micro_interactions: Every button and input must have clear hover, active, and focus micro-states.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous padding (p-6 to p-8) inside cards to prevent content collision.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use Sonner for toast notifications (imported from '@/components/ui/sonner').
